text: Jennifer Widom, born in 1960 or 1961, is an American computer scientist renowned for her foundational work in database systems and data management, particularly in semi-structured data management and data stream management systems. Since 2017, she has served as the dean of the School of Engineering and holds the position of professor of computer science at Stanford University. She is the Fletcher Jones Professor of Computer Science and has received multiple lifetime achievement awards from the Association for Computing Machinery. Widom earned a bachelor's degree in trumpet performance from the Indiana University Jacobs School of Music in 1982 and a PhD in computer science under David Gries from Cornell University in 1987. She began her career as a researcher at the IBM Almaden Research Center and joined Stanford University as a professor in 1993. She chaired the Stanford computer science department from 2009 to 2014 and served as senior associate dean for faculty and academic affairs in the School of Engineering from 2014 to 2016. In February 2017, she was named Dean of the School of Engineering. Widom is a fellow of the Association for Computing Machinery since 2005 and received the ACM-W Athena Lecturer Award in 2015 for her contributions to active database systems. She is also a member of the National Academy of Engineering and the American Academy of Arts and Sciences. Widom has co-authored four academic textbooks on database systems that cover database design, use, and implementation of applications and management systems, and these materials are used at junior, senior, and graduate levels in the computer science department. In late 2011, she launched one of the first Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs), titled "Introduction to Databases," which had over 100,000 enrolled students and launched simultaneously with two other MOOCs by Stanford University School of Engineering faculty. In 2018, she was awarded the Erna Hamburger prize by the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne - Women in Science and Humanities Foundation for her work with MOOCs. Widom is the daughter of Lois Widom and Harold Widom, an American mathematician, and her uncle Benjamin Widom is a faculty member in chemistry at Cornell University. She is married to Alex Aiken, who previously served as chair of Stanford's computer science department, and they have a son and a daughter.
